title: Resource-aware local, remote, and multi-GPU worker scheduler
properties: Registration is credential-authenticated and stores only a credential digest.
Placement checks aggregate RAM, VRAM, disk, CPU, GPU, and concurrency capacity.
Expired leases retry within a bounded attempt count.
Stale leases cannot complete and duplicate identical publication is idempotent.
Unsupported capability and budget cases remain explicit and queued or rejected.
negative_cells: CPU-only worker cannot receive VRAM work.
A mismatched registration credential is rejected.
A conflicting duplicate result cannot overwrite the published result.
